source: Original generated fantasy Foley. Mono 48 kHz Opus; quiet lead trimmed; peak target 0.56; 3 ms attack and 20 ms tail fades. Runtime mixer attenuates each accent. Measurements do not establish perceived quality.

assets.prompt: One compact medieval steel buckler impact for a warm hand-painted fantasy game. Immediate firm wooden thud with a bright small metal clink and short natural ring dying into silence. Dry close Foley, weighty but friendly. Single hit, no music, voice, drone or ambience, no long reverb.

One fast short dagger slash for a nimble fantasy rogue. Close dry layered leather movement and a fine steel blade cutting air, brisk attack then clean soft decay. Precise tactile Foley, not a cartoon laser. Single gesture, no music, voice, rhythmic repeats or background ambience.

One crisp fantasy bow release: close dry taut bowstring twang, short wooden flex and a fine airy arrow whisk with a tiny sparkling crackle. Immediate response and short controlled decay. Detailed warm Foley, no music, voices, long reverb or background ambience.

One compact hand-cast fire burst for a storybook fantasy battle. Sudden warm low ignition puff with textured flame whoosh and a few crisp embers, dying quickly to silence. Powerful tactile sound at small scale, no huge cinematic boom. No voices, music, repeating pulses or background.

One playful but weighty clockwork gadget throw for a fantasy goblin engineer: an immediate small metal latch clack, spring release, wood-and-brass rattle and short low thump. A single coherent quick action with a clean short tail. Dry Foley, no music, voices, ambience or extra repeated actions.

One magical healing potion splash for a cozy fantasy healer. Immediate rounded glass clink and rich liquid glug blooming into a soft sparkling watery splash, then clean short decay. Organic tactile friendly Foley, no electronic beep. Single action, no voice, music or background ambience.
